rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" MAKEINFO=true \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/automake" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/aclocal"
ln -sf automake-1.16 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/automake" ln -sf aclocal-1.16 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/aclocal"
